findings.problem: In everyday speech, 'see you next week' is 'Nos vemos la próxima semana' or 'la semana que viene'; 'la semana siguiente' means the week after some other point in time, so this sentence sounds unnatural as a goodbye.
findings.fix: example.es: Me bajo en la siguiente parada. / example.en: I'm getting off at the next stop.

note: The hint names próximo to rule it out, which works, but it shows the learner the other answer.
